snippet.title: Learn Guitar: Walk-through of Gibson App for Beginner Guitarists
snippet.description:
Your guitar journey starts here. Beginner friendly, and for all skill levels. Works with any guitar. Learn how to play acoustic and electric guitar - rhythm and lead. You'll be playing your favorite songs, soloing and improvising in no time!

Have a piano 🎹 or guitar and want chords or jam with your favorite songs? Check out Rechords app by Zoundio (iOS only): https://apple.co/3SEahDz
